path.description: The template file, absolute: <config dir>/templates/<name>.json, as listed (a symlink is not resolved).

description.description: The template's description; null when it has none, and when the template file itself is corrupt or unreadable (a bad prompt file leaves it).

template.description: The template's content as parsed, in the template schema's keys, with cwd and prompt_file as written (a leading ~/ not expanded, the prompt file not inlined). Nested so its own name key can't clash with the entry's. null when the template file itself is corrupt or unreadable; a bad prompt file leaves it.

problem.description: Why spawn would refuse this template; null when it would not.

kind.description: An error kind, as spawn would raise it. Open set.

path.description: The file at fault: the template, its prompt file, or (not-found) the prompt file's resolved absolute path.
